Bulma 1.0.2
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bulma@1.0.2/css/bulma.min.css
License: MIT (https://github.com/jgthms/bulma/blob/master/LICENSE)

Vendored as a single CSS file, no JS -- Bulma has no JS component of its
own (unlike Bootstrap, which needs Popper for dropdowns/tooltips). Every
interactive behavior in this app (tabs switching, comment editor expand,
drag-and-drop, ...) is still plain hand-written JS in frontend/*.js;
Bulma only supplies the CSS classes/grid.

To update: re-download bulma.min.css from the URL above at a newer
version tag, replace this file, bump the version note here.
